response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.avg_rate AS gap FROM project_rates pr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE pr.rate > b.avg_rate ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10;
